import matplotlib
matplotlib.rcParams["pdf.fonttype"] = 42
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupKFold

from benchmark.models import make_gbm, FEATURES

STATES = ["productive", "exploring", "help-seeking", "stalled", "stalled-after-error", "off-task"]

def load(course, labels):
    w = pd.read_parquet(f"data/{course}/windows.parquet")
    return w.merge(pd.read_csv(f"data/{course}/{labels}"), on="window_id")

cs1 = load("cs1_fall25", "labels_adjudicated.csv")
cs2 = load("cs2_summer26", "labels_minsun_0718.csv")

within = []
for tr, te in GroupKFold(5).split(cs1, groups=cs1.student_id):
    m = make_gbm().fit(cs1.iloc[tr][FEATURES], cs1.iloc[tr].label)
    within.append(f1_score(cs1.iloc[te].label, m.predict(cs1.iloc[te][FEATURES]), labels=STATES, average=None))
within = np.mean(within, axis=0)

m = make_gbm().fit(cs1[FEATURES], cs1.label)
cross = f1_score(cs2.label, m.predict(cs2[FEATURES]), labels=STATES, average=None)

tab = pd.DataFrame({"state": STATES, "within_cs1": within.round(2), "cs1_to_cs2": cross.round(2)})
tab.to_csv("figures/cross_course_f1.csv", index=False)
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
print("macro", within.mean().round(3), cross.mean().round(3))

x = np.arange(len(STATES))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.4, 2.0))
ax.bar(x - 0.2, within, 0.4, label="within CS1 (5-fold)", color="#4C72B0")
ax.bar(x + 0.2, cross, 0.4, label="CS1 → CS2", color="#DD8452")
ax.set_xticks(x, STATES, rotation=35, ha="right", fontsize=6)
ax.set_ylabel("F1"); ax.set_ylim(0, 1); ax.legend(fontsize=6, frameon=False)
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("figures/fig7_cross_course.pdf")
